task.description:
Write the test specification and integration test code for PD-04 (Definition lifecycle).

**1. Create test specification at `tests/specs/PD-04.md`**

Model it after `tests/specs/PD-03.md`. Include one test case per PD-04 acceptance criterion:

- TC-PD-04-01: DRAFT → ACTIVE via activate() — success (already covered by PD-03 tests; reference only; do not duplicate the test)
- TC-PD-04-02: ACTIVE → DEPRECATED via deprecate() — success
- TC-PD-04-03: DEPRECATED → ARCHIVED via archive() — success; archived_at is set
- TC-PD-04-04: Forbidden transition DRAFT → DEPRECATED (deprecate a DRAFT) → InvalidStatusTransition
- TC-PD-04-05: Forbidden transition DRAFT → ARCHIVED (archive a DRAFT) → InvalidStatusTransition
- TC-PD-04-06: Forbidden transition ACTIVE → ARCHIVED (archive an ACTIVE) → InvalidStatusTransition
- TC-PD-04-07: ARCHIVED terminal state — deprecate() on ARCHIVED → InvalidStatusTransition
- TC-PD-04-08: ARCHIVED terminal state — archive() on ARCHIVED → InvalidStatusTransition
- TC-PD-04-09: ARCHIVED terminal state — activate() on ARCHIVED → NotDraft (HTTP 409; already covered by activate() returning NotDraft for non-DRAFT — include here for completeness)
- TC-PD-04-10: deprecate() on a non-existent id → DefinitionNotFound
- TC-PD-04-11: archive() on a non-existent id → DefinitionNotFound
- TC-PD-04-12: New instance start blocked for DEPRECATED definition (informational — may require EE-01 context; mark as out-of-scope for this test run if EE-01 is not yet implemented; note the dependency)

**2. Create integration test file at `tests/integration/pd04_lifecycle_test.zig`**

Model after the existing integration test files in `tests/integration/`. Use `TestHarness.init()` / `TestHarness.deinit()` and the `cleanupByName()` helper pattern seen in PD-03 tests.

Each test case MUST:
- Set up its own test data (create definitions with the required status by chaining activate/deprecate)
- Clean up via `cleanupByName()` in a defer block
- Assert the exact error type on failure paths
- Assert the returned Definition has the correct status on success paths
- Assert that `archived_at` is non-null after archive()

Do NOT test TC-PD-04-12 in this file (it depends on EE-01 which is not yet implemented).
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/PD-04.md exists with test cases for all PD-04 acceptance criteria
tests/integration/pd04_lifecycle_test.zig exists and compiles (zig build test exits 0)
Tests cover all permitted and forbidden transitions
Tests verify archived_at is set after archive()
Tests use TestHarness and cleanupByName() per the test guide

result.summary: Created tests/specs/PD-04.md with 12 test cases covering all PD-04 acceptance criteria (permitted transitions DRAFT→ACTIVE reference, ACTIVE→DEPRECATED, DEPRECATED→ARCHIVED with archived_at verification; forbidden transitions DRAFT→DEPRECATED, DRAFT→ARCHIVED, ACTIVE→ARCHIVED, ARCHIVED→DEPRECATED, ARCHIVED→ARCHIVED; activate on ARCHIVED reference; not-found paths for both deprecate() and archive(); TC-PD-04-12 marked out-of-scope pending EE-01). Created tests/integration/pd04_lifecycle_test.zig with 9 executable test cases (TC-PD-04-02 through TC-PD-04-11 excluding reference-only and out-of-scope cases) following the TestHarness.init()/deinit() and cleanupByName() patterns from pd03_version_test.zig. All tests compile successfully (zig build test exits 0).
